differences.a_observable: The card below the yellow Recurly card is blank white.
differences.b_observable: The card below the yellow Recurly card displays the blue 'Live Now' text and border.
differences.fix: Hide the 'Live Now' graphics until the animation trigger.

differences.a_observable: The yellow and blue cards feature highly saturated, vibrant tones.
differences.b_observable: The yellow and blue cards appear washed out with lower saturation.
differences.fix: Boost color saturation and contrast to match the reference grading.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Animate the 'Live Now' card to slide out from under the Recurly card instead of rendering it static.

claim.a_observable: The 'Live Now' card slides out horizontally from under the Recurly card.
claim.b_observable: The 'Live Now' card remains static with no slide-out animation.
claim.fix: Implement the horizontal slide-out animation for the 'Live Now' card.

differences.a_observable: Dynamic perspective with the camera close to the Juspay card, making it appear prominent.
differences.b_observable: Flatter perspective with the camera positioned further away, reducing the visual impact of the card.
differences.fix: Bring the camera closer and widen the field of view to match the reference perspective.

differences.a_observable: The silver border of the Juspay card has a brushed metallic texture.
differences.b_observable: The border is a flat, matte grey material with no texture.
differences.fix: Apply a brushed metal texture map to the card border material.

differences.a_observable: Strong vignette darkening the corners of the frame.
differences.b_observable: Flat, uniform lighting across the frame with no vignette.
differences.fix: Add a vignette in post-production to match the reference falloff.

differences.a_observable: The Recurly card features a warm, highly saturated golden yellow.
differences.b_observable: The Recurly card features a cooler, less saturated pale yellow.
differences.fix: Adjust the diffuse color of the Recurly card to a warmer, more saturated yellow.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera field of view and distance to match the dynamic perspective, and add a vignette to correct the flat lighting.

differences.a_observable: The camera is positioned close to the cards, creating a tight composition with a distinct low-angle perspective.
differences.b_observable: The camera is positioned further away, resulting in a loose composition with a flatter, more top-down perspective.
differences.fix: Adjust camera position and focal length to match the tight, low-angle perspective of Video A.

differences.a_observable: The scene features high-contrast lighting with deep shadows and a prominent vignette around the frame.
differences.b_observable: The scene features flat, uniform lighting with very bright highlights and almost no vignette.
differences.fix: Increase contrast of the lighting, deepen shadows, and add a vignette to match Video A.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly card has a satin-like finish with soft specular reflections.
differences.b_observable: The yellow Recurly card has a completely flat, matte texture with no specular highlights.
differences.fix: Adjust material roughness and specularity of the yellow card to match the satin finish in Video A.

runs.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera framing and angle to match the tight, dynamic composition of Video A, and increase the lighting contrast.
